cookieBannerBody: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and run MOVINIGHT. Optional cookies are off unless you allow them.
faqIntro: Short answers about organizations, invites, cookies, and your data rights.
faqOrgA: An organization is your private movie crew. Watchlists, nights, ratings, and restaurants belong to that org and are not shared with other orgs.
faqCodeA: Each org has a short code (for example weebs). Enter it after signing in to join. Owners can change the code anytime.
faqInviteA: Owners can invite people by email. The invite link expires in 7 days and must be accepted while signed in with the invited email.
faqCookiesA: Necessary cookies support authentication and security. Optional cookies stay off by default until you allow them in the banner.
faqRightsA: Under applicable privacy laws including Saudi PDPL principles we follow, you can request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data. You can delete your account in profile settings or email us.
faqTermsQ: Why do I need to accept Terms?
faqTermsA: We ask you to accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before creating or joining an organization so everyone understands how the app and data work.
metaFaqDescription: Organizations, invites, cookies, and privacy questions for MOVINIGHT.
privacyCookiesBody: We use necessary cookies for sign-in and security. Optional cookies (for example analytics) are disabled until you consent via the cookie banner. You can change preferences anytime.
privacyOrgsBody: Shared watchlists, nights, and related activity are stored in the organization you join. Other organizations cannot see that data. Invites include the email address you invite.
privacyPdplBody: Consistent with PDPL-aligned practices, you may request access, correction, or deletion of personal data by using in-app account deletion or contacting {email}.
termsOrgsBody: You may create or join organizations via codes or email invites. Org-scoped content belongs to that organization. Do not share invite links or codes outside your intended group. Owners are responsible for managing members and invites in their org.
